en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 14 - It is narrated from Ahmad bin Mehran from Muhammad bin Ali from Ziyad bin Marwan Qandi, who was from the Waqifiya sect that he said:

I visited Abu Ibrahim [Imam Kadhim (a.s)]. With him was Abul Hasan [Ali Ridha (a.s)], his son. Imam (a.s) said: Ziyad, this is my son, Ali. His writing is my writing, his words are my words, his messenger is my messenger, and whatever he says, (the truth) is what he says.
